# The Apprentice Pledge

> A UK movement of founders, leaders, and employers committing to hire, train, and develop at least one apprentice.

The Apprentice Pledge invites employers to publicly commit to opening doors for the next generation. Signers join a growing community building the UK's future talent pipeline, with early access to upcoming apprenticeship pathways in creative, media, and marketing sectors, and an official Apprentice Pledge badge to share.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Learn why hiring an apprentice matters and take the pledge.
- [Blog](/blog): Insights and data on apprenticeships and UK hiring.
- [UK Unemployment Data](/unemployment): Latest ONS unemployment figures, visualised.
